## Xbox app
- **Build → Build for Xbox** now has two kinds. **Web game** is the Edge build as before. **Xbox app** writes a Visual Studio project (UWP, C#) that runs the game in WebView2, the Chromium engine Xbox ships. Open the .sln in Visual Studio 2022 (Universal Windows Platform workload) and press F5: it runs on the PC right away, deploys to an Xbox in Dev Mode, and can be sold on the Xbox Store through the Xbox Live Creators Program.
- It uses the name, version, icon and Store identity from Build for Windows. README-Xbox-app.txt has every step for the PC, Dev Mode and the Store.
